title: Writing the dweb: Wallet and storage APIs
description: Hands-on workshop at Dappcon Berlin on writing to the decentralized web with Freedom Browser. Participants publish content to Swarm and IPFS using the browser’s integrated wallet API and navigator.freedom storage APIs, then resolve it via ENS — without centralized backends or HTTP gateways.

title: A Browser for the Decentralized Web
speaker: Meinhard Benn
description: Meinhard Benn of Freedom Browser presents “A Browser for the Decentralized Web” at BREW Privacy Matters 2026 in Berlin, Germany.

title: Freedom: Reinventing the Browser
description: Talk at Dappcon Berlin on rebuilding the web from first principles with Freedom Browser — native ENS resolution, direct IPFS and Swarm access, self-sovereign identity, and no dependency on centralized gateways.

title: Decentralization Is a Lie (Until This Works)
speaker: Meinhard Benn
description: In this Web3Privacy Now Academy interview, Meinhard Benn explains how Freedom Browser turns your device into a node for IPFS and Swarm, removing reliance on centralized gateways so access to the decentralized web is simple and direct.

title: Freedom Browser Interview
speaker: Meinhard Benn
description: Meinhard Benn, founder of Freedom Browser, joins Paul Barron Network to discuss the minimalist browser for Swarm and IPFS — direct peer connections without centralized gateways, ENS, publishing, and open-source censorship resistance.

title: Freedom: A Browser for the Decentralized Web
speaker: Meinhard Benn
description: Meinhard Benn presents Freedom at EthCC: a desktop browser that treats Swarm, IPFS, and ENS as first-class protocols, with integrated peer-to-peer nodes for direct network access without centralized gateways.
